description: Holds verify's verifiers to three rules: for a PR whose author is not trusted, the spec verifier gets the same answer for the spec's commands and the tests (scripts/verifier-flags.mjs); a verifier runs commands only in its own worktree (scripts/verifier-worktree.mjs); and a verifier leaves no worktree or branch behind, except a branch that holds a commit on no remote branch (scripts/verifier-cleanup.mjs). Every other call passes through unchanged.
